name: std::moneypunct<CharT,International>::~moneypunct
intro: Destructs a std::moneypunct facet. This destructor is protected and virtual (due to base class destructor being virtual). An object of type std::moneypunct, like most facets, can only be destroyed when the last std::locale object that implements this facet goes out of scope or if a user-defined class is derived from std::moneypunct and implements a public destructor.
